recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, grainy live performance photograph of two vocalists in suits under dramatic stage lighting, topped with a distinct pill-shaped graphic badge containing stacked, heavy-shadowed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the dark, atmospheric stage photography and the bright, flat graphic badge.
The upward gaze of the performers directing attention toward the top-center text.
The repetition of deep drop shadows in the text mirroring the high-contrast stage shadows.
coreInvariants: Heavy, multi-layered drop shadows on text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two primary vocalists occupy the center and right-center foreground, scaled to fill the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The cream-colored pill-shaped badge at the top center acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright top badge, follow the microphone stands down to the performers, and sweep across the stage action.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows and dark stage background provide significant negative space on the left and bottom.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and charcoal blacks in the photographic background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream/off-white for the badge background to provide maximum legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted orange-red and lavender-purple for the letter faces.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the photo contrasted with high-value, medium-saturation graphic elements.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital vibrance.
Limit to a 1960s soul aesthetic palette.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, condensed sans-serif with rounded terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Extremely deep, hard-edged drop shadows extending down and to the right.
Stacked layout within a rounded container.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand is stylized to match the weight of the primary letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in two different colors to distinguish between artist and title.
graphicDevices: Pill-shaped container with a thin double-line border.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed profile.
Offers a clean, bold mid-century look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy, high-contrast 1960s live concert photo of two male soul singers in suits performing on a dark stage with blue-tinted spotlights and visible microphones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a cream-colored pill-shaped badge at the top center. Inside, place two lines of bold, condensed, uppercase sans-serif text. The top line should be orange-red and the bottom line lavender-purple, both featuring a deep, dark brown 3D drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the text contained within a rounded 'stadium' shape?
Does the photo have a visible film grain and cool color cast?
Are the drop shadows hard-edged and deep?
Is the typography stacked and centered?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
postGenerationChecks: Check that the badge does not obscure the performers' faces.
Ensure the drop shadow direction is consistent across all letters.
Verify the film grain is uniform across the photographic area.
Confirm the color palette feels mid-century rather than contemporary.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast, grainy performance photo with a top-weighted, pill-shaped graphic badge containing heavy-shadowed, condensed sans-serif display type.
